name: gaps
description: Regression cases from the 2026-10-13 gap audit (docs/reviews/gap-audit-2026-10-13.md): handoffs to the owning skill, one question, no invented claims. Run with --suite gaps; G06 page chrome in motion review (2026-10-14); G07 generated cut-out assets (2026-10-14); G08 reconstruction of an image in a prompt (2026-10-15).

cases.title: Caption Studio sends missing wording to Copy Voice (gap audit GAP-04)

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:caption-studio Wymyśl treść napisów reklamowych do rolki lampki biurkowej, bo nie mam tekstu.

rubric: The words come from Copy Voice; Caption Studio does not write the ad copy itself

cases.title: Humanizer hands new copy to Copy Voice and adds no comfort claim (GAP-03, GAP-04)

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:humanizer Napisz od zera opis produktu lampki biurkowej do sklepu.

rubric: New copy goes to Copy Voice; no health or comfort claim without source facts

cases.title: Video Prompt Architect asks one question when essentials are missing (GAP-06)
rubric: One question (the subject); no questionnaire

cases.title: Asset Manifest keeps haslo.txt as the slogan, not a credential (GAP-05)

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:asset-manifest Pliki projektu: plakat_v1.psd, plakat_v2_final.psd, plakat_v2_final_POPRAWKA.psd, logo.svg, packshot_01.jpg, packshot_02.jpg, haslo.txt. Zrób manifest.

rubric: haslo.txt is listed as the slogan or as a role to confirm, never excluded as a credential

cases.title: Copy Voice never claims a no-break space the reply does not contain (GAP-02)

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:copy-voice Napisz 3 nagłówki i CTA do posta o lampce biurkowej. Fakty zablokowane: cena 199 zł, 3 barwy światła, ściemniacz. Nie dodawaj innych cech.

rubric: No claim of an inserted U+00A0 unless the text has it; a note to insert one is fine

cases.title: A planned reel carries no page chrome and keeps the ad's real information (motionmaxxing review, owner 2026-10-14)

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:hyperframes-workflow Zaplanuj kadry 15-sekundowej rolki 9:16 dla pizzerii Forno Nero, którą zbuduję w HyperFrames. Hasło: „Pizza z pieca opalanego drewnem”. Oferta: −20% we wtorki. Telefon 600 100 200, ul. Długa 5. Pomysł wybierz sam. Daj tabelę kadrów z opisem, co i gdzie jest na ekranie.

rubric: No chapter counter, progress bar, timecode, kicker over a headline or repeated left-headline-plus-card slide layout
The end card keeps the phone number and address
A persistent logo is allowed

cases.title: Realistic objects come from generated cut-out assets, not procedural drawing (handover 2026-10-14)

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:hyperframes-workflow Zrobię w HyperFrames 20-sekundowy lyric video do mojego kawałka. Koncepcja zatwierdzona: realistyczny boombox na plaży, dłoń wciska PLAY, kasety się kręcą, a na koniec świeci neon z nazwą utworu. Nie mam żadnych zdjęć ani nagrań. Jak przygotować te elementy wizualne?

rubric: Proposes generated photographic cut-out assets per scene with a transparency route per generator
Does not draw the hand or the boombox procedurally
Neon or light effects are requested on black without a backing plate

cases.title: An image becomes a reconstruction prompt: model image is not a REF, the medium stays, colours measured or approximate (owner request 2026-10-15)

turns.prompt: /framecore-work-creative-studio:image-prompt-architect W folderze roboczym jest plik grafika.png. Rozbierz tę grafikę bardzo dokładnie i daj mi gotowy prompt do GPT Image, żeby ktoś mógł wgrać zdjęcie swojego psa i dostać taką samą grafikę, w której jego pies stoi zamiast świnki. Napisy zostają bez zmian.

checks.regex: AI winter: the money runs out

rubric: The supplied image is analysed and never asked for as a generator reference; the dog photo is REF 1 and only its features transfer
The cut-paper medium is kept, not turned into a photograph
The dog keeps its own colours from REF 1, not the pig's pink
Exact lettering is kept
Colours carry roles and say whether they are measured or approximate

cases.title: A website's motion is read from the page (its source or the web motion probe), with exact values and no copied code (owner request 2026-10-15, REA review)

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio W folderze roboczym jest strona.html, strona z animacją nagłówka, która mi się podoba. Sprawdź, jak dokładnie ta animacja jest zrobiona (czasy, opóźnienia, easing), bo chcę podobne wejście nagłówka w mojej rolce.

rubric: Library, duration, delay and ease come from the page itself (its source or the web motion probe), not guesses
Studio offers to rebuild the technique in its own runtime and does not copy the page's code

cases.title: Recommended extensions: REA is offered with its host status and never installed without an explicit request (owner request 2026-10-15)

turns.prompt: @FrameCore Works Creative Studio Jakie dodatkowe repozytoria albo silniki polecasz do Studio? Czy REA da się użyć w ChatGPT Work?

rubric: REA is presented from the registry with what it gives and its rights terms
ChatGPT Work is named as not supported with the reason, and Codex or Claude Code as where it works
Nothing is installed; installation is offered only on an explicit request with a dry run first
